# Prior distributions

Allowed values of `dist` in a free coefficient's `prior:` block, with their
required parameters. No other distributions exist.

| dist | parameters | example |
|---|---|---|
| `gaussian` | `mean`, `std` | `{dist: gaussian, mean: 0.0, std: 1.0}` |
| `normal` | `mean`, `std` | `{dist: normal, mean: 0.0, std: 1.0}` (alias of gaussian) |
| `uniform` | `low`, `high` | `{dist: uniform, low: -1.0, high: 1.0}` |

Special cases (selected automatically, never via `dist`):

- `whitening:` block — every free coefficient gets `uniform[-sigma_prior, sigma_prior]`
  in whitened space.
- `bayesian_update:` — the previous fit's exact posterior becomes the prior.
